title: Duplication of bluetooth meter values messing with graph and calibration
symptom: Historic glucose levels from Accu-Check Aviva Connect sync sometimes suddenly appear on the graph at a wrong time, e.g., a reading taken at 8 AM appears again at 14:30 after a later measurement, and these duplicates can mess with Libre calibration. The issue also occurs with Contour Next meters.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause, but suggests it is caused by bluetooth sync, and a commenter identifies trigger conditions: meter connected, automatic calibration enabled, doing a BG test without calibrating, then opening xDrip after 30 minutes causes the earlier BG value to be applied as calibration.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix, but a workaround is suggested: disabling automatic calibration or clicking on the BG in the graph and calibrating. The original reporter later states they have not observed the issue in many months and assumes it is fixed.
evidence_quote: Workaround seems to be disabling automatic calibration or click on BG in graph and calibrate.
